verdict.rationale: Perplexity is an AI assistant and agent platform, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence only documents Perplexity serving MCP to other clients (its MCP Server and the Computer MCP server) and a managed connector framework for 400+ services. Neither shows users plugging their own MCP servers into Perplexity so it can call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
